name: Owner messages
ownerWords: have a look at threads like metal-management. it's a loooong ass list of pointless messages right? each turn/check-in doesn't necessarily have to tell user send_message. the ultimate goal is high-precision, high-recall. make it like a Slack chat between CTO and VP. fix it so it behaves like mentioned
goal: The owner's real chats message him only when he needs it, like a VP's Slack DMs to a CTO (c117, goal p684): a goal he asked for finished, a decision only he can make, a blocker only he can clear, or the answer to his question, and every message of his gets a reply. On 10-18 they sent 597 messages a day and about 52% were needed; after the tell_owner check (a39e0718 to d711257) the 12 h read from 03:19Z to 15:19Z on 10-20 had 12 of 13 needed. The noise kinds seen so far are on the wiki page domains/devops/owner-message-precision.

metrics.label: Messages to the owner in the last 24 h that he needed, in percent (a reply on his own turn counts as needed)
Messages on turns he did not start with no needed or noise label that a d11 job already had the chance to label
His message bursts older than 30 min with no reply

onMiss: Read the precheck's flagged items. For each `unlabeled` item, decide needed or noise against the goal's four cases from the chat's board and the wake it shows, and append one line per item to ~/.prime/agent/browser-chat/owner-messages/labels.jsonl as {"id": <the id in the excerpt>, "label": "needed" or "noise", "case": <the case, or the noise kind in a few words, such as progress relay, second report on a goal already reported, incident status sent as blocker>}. Label every item in this run yourself, without a job, since it is a read of a few lines. Name a noise line's case with the kind from NOISE_FIXES in scripts/duties/noise-split.ts when one fits, and add "on a pre-<hash> build" when the chat that sent it ran a build without that kind's fix. When needed_pct_24h still misses after labelling and the precheck marks every noise line before its fix, or its miss line says no new event came since the last run, start no job: the share rises as those lines leave the 24 h, and the precheck's `aging` item says when it meets the target with no new noise. Otherwise count each after-fix or no-fix noise kind over the labels file's last 7 days. A kind with 3 or more lines whose fix is not live, or any after-fix line, gets a fix step under a new goal on this chat's board with duty "<this duty's id>/needed_pct_24h" and a job that changes the tell_owner check in legacy/prime/user-history/src/chat-guard.ts the way a39e0718 to d711257 did: it refuses the call once, the very same text sent again goes out, and the owner's own turns are never held. The fix job adds its kind and commit to NOISE_FIXES. An `unanswered` item is a recall miss: tell the chat it names with agent_message what message is waiting, and if that chat has no chat tools or its turn failed, start a job that gets it answering. End with no message to the owner when every metric is met.
